related.title: 超導磁體低溫系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「拉莫進動與自旋極化」與「勻場、磁場均勻度與線形校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；超導磁體低溫系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Larmor precession and spin polarisation" and "Shimming, field homogeneity and line-shape calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦拉莫頻率、化學位移、超導磁體與鎖場、探頭訊噪比、勻場與定量 NMR 的弛豫預算；超導磁體低溫系統則以NbTi/Nb₃Sn 臨界面、4 K 熱負載預算、電流引線、失超保護與持續電流運轉為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on larmor frequency, chemical shift, superconducting magnet and lock, probe signal-to-noise, shimming and relaxation budgets for quantitative NMR; Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets centres on NbTi/Nb3Sn critical surface, 4 K heat-load budget, current leads, quench protection and persistent-mode operation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「主磁場中的核自旋」與「NbTi 導體工作點」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超導磁體低溫系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「失超偵測、儲能 ½LI² 與氦氣釋放」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Nuclear spins in the main field” and “NbTi conductor operating point”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cryogenic systems for superconducting magnets, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Quench detection, stored energy ½LI² and helium release", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Larmor precession and spin polarisation" and "Shimming, field homogeneity and line-shape calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Time-of-flight mass spectrometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦拉莫頻率、化學位移、超導磁體與鎖場、探頭訊噪比、勻場與定量 NMR 的弛豫預算；飛行時間質譜儀則以飛行時間方程、解析力、反射器能量聚焦、MCP 與 TDC 計時、質量校正與正交加速工作週期為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on larmor frequency, chemical shift, superconducting magnet and lock, probe signal-to-noise, shimming and relaxation budgets for quantitative NMR; Time-of-flight mass spectrometers centres on flight-time equation, resolving power, reflectron energy focusing, MCP and TDC timing, mass calibration and orthogonal-acceleration duty cycle, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「主磁場中的核自旋」與「加速區與無場漂移管」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到飛行時間質譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「計數統計、死時間與動態範圍」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Nuclear spins in the main field” and “Acceleration region and field-free drift tube”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Time-of-flight mass spectrometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Counting statistics, dead time and dynamic range", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 核磁共振光譜儀
history.text: 1938 年 Rabi 以分子束觀測到核磁共振，1945–46 年 Felix Bloch（史丹佛）與 Edward Purcell（哈佛）分別在凝態物質中偵測到 NMR，兩人共獲 1952 年諾貝爾物理獎；1950 年前後發現化學位移與 J 耦合，使 NMR 成為化學結構工具。1966 年 Richard Ernst 與 Weston Anderson 在 Varian 發展脈衝傅立葉轉換 NMR，Ernst 獲 1991 年諾貝爾化學獎；超導磁體從 1960 年代起不斷提高場強，Kurt Wüthrich 以 NMR 解析蛋白質結構獲 2002 年諾貝爾化學獎，2020 年起含高溫超導內插線圈的 1.2 GHz（28.2 T）磁體投入使用。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1938 Rabi observed nuclear magnetic resonance in molecular beams, and in 1945–46 Felix Bloch at Stanford and Edward Purcell at Harvard independently detected NMR in condensed matter, sharing the 1952 Nobel Prize in Physics; the discovery of chemical shift and J coupling around 1950 made NMR a tool for chemical structure. In 1966 Richard Ernst and Weston Anderson at Varian developed pulsed Fourier-transform NMR, earning Ernst the 1991 Nobel Prize in Chemistry; superconducting magnets have raised field strength since the 1960s, Kurt Wüthrich received the 2002 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein structures by NMR, and from 2020 magnets of 1.2 GHz (28.2 T) with high-temperature-superconductor inserts entered service. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「拉莫進動與自旋極化」到「儀器驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Larmor precession and spin polarisation" through "Instrument acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
